author: Stahly
description:
Trench Crusade's first physical campaign box has arrived, and it's carrying a lot of weight on its shoulders: two brand new plastic warbands, a hefty lore-packed campaign book, and the promise of doubling as an entry point for newcomers to the setting. In this review, we unbox every component of Carcass Front in a 4K video, walk through the full campaign book, and show you high-res sprue images for the Heretic Naval Raiders, Procession of the Sacred Affliction, and the terrain and tokens. Leviathan awakes!

The post Carcass Front review: Leviathan rises in Trench Crusade’s ambitious new campaign box appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Carcass Front review: Leviathan rises in Trench Crusade’s ambitious new campaign box
